readme:
# Ideogram 4.6 Text to Image

Ideogram 4.6 generates images with reliable text rendering and polished graphic design, at four quality levels.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 10,000 characters. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `21:9` / `16:9` / `3:2` / `4:3` / `5:4` / `1:1` / `4:5` / `3:4` / `2:3` / `9:16` | — | Output shape. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |
| `quality` | `very_low` / `low` / `medium` / `high` | `medium` | Sets the per-image rate. |

## Billing
Per image: $0.008 very_low, $0.03 low, $0.06 medium, $0.10 high.
| Quality | Price |
|---|---|
| very_low | $0.008 |
| low | $0.03 |
| medium | $0.06 |
| high | $0.10 |
Failed runs are not charged.
## Prompting

- Quote all text that must appear.

## Limits

- One image per request.

## Also on SandBase
Related: `ideogram/4.6/edit`, `ideogram/4.5`.
